blocks.text: DUMAGUETE CITY — Police seized an estimated P7.8 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested a high-value drug suspect in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Balugo here on Friday morning, Oct. 2. Personnel of the Dumaguete City Police Station’s City Drug Enforcement Unit conducted the operation at 11:19 a.m. in Purok Santol. This action resulted in the arrest of a 35-year-old resident of Barangay Batinguel, identified as alias “John,” the Police Regional Office-Negros Island Region (PRO-NIR) reported.
